name: Mosshide Fen
summary: In eastern Wetlands, Mosshide Fen is held by the Mosshide gnolls. Its primitive camps lie far from the main trade roads, where travelers face danger.

sections.title: Territory of the Pack
sections.body: Mosshide gnolls hold the tangled marsh of eastern Wetlands. Rough lean-tos and bone-strewn camps mark their territory. Gnawbone and other pack leaders command the tribe, which ambushes and devours travelers, scouts, and prospectors who enter its hunting grounds.

faq.answer: Mosshide Fen lies in eastern Wetlands, where sodden marshland is claimed and settled by the Mosshide gnolls.
The Mosshide gnolls occupy the fen under brutal leaders such as Gnawbone, who commands his pack to capture and devour outsiders trespassing on their land.

faq.q: Why is this area dangerous to travelers?
faq.answer: Mosshide gnolls are aggressive and hungry. Travelers who leave established paths or search the wet brush for supplies risk sudden ambush by hunting packs.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you must keep watch on Mosshide Fen. Its aggressive gnoll packs threaten prospectors searching the marshes and scouts securing the eastern paths.
